subject: 🐋 Your trial ends tomorrow
preview: No pressure. One easy way to try it, and what happens next.
h1_bold: There's still time for one small step.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: Maybe the timing just hasn't worked out this week. That happens. If you'd still like to see what MindSync is like, tonight is a good moment: open Reflect and tell Orca how your week has been. You can say it out loud, since voice mode is included in your trial until it ends tomorrow.

blocks.alt: Two MindSync screens: a Reflect conversation with Orca, and the What Orca remembers page

blocks.text: If you want to keep Premium, pick a plan in the app, under Subscription. If you'd rather not, you don't need to do anything. Nothing is charged automatically, and your account moves to the free version. Anything you've saved stays saved.
Not sure MindSync fits the way you work with your therapist? Hit reply and tell me what's missing. It comes straight to me.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.

sources.item: recordings, notes and summaries stay saved either way
